items.title: Your Mac Isn't Actually Slow, It's MacOS Fault
items.summary:
If npm installs feel slow on your Mac and deleting node_modules takes forever, it's not your hardware because the same install that finished in under 10 seconds on my Linux machine took over 30 seconds on my Mac

items.transcript: SSH kind of [ __ ] sucks. It's really useful, really powerful, and I spend a ton of time in SSH. But as soon as my connection isn't perfect, I end up with all sorts of problems. I was getting sticky keys while I typed trying to do work in Cloud Code. It turned out it was bound to the Wi-Fi, not to my ethernet. But the fact that I even had to care is absurd.
